chunks: And ʿĀmir ibn ʿAbdillāh ibn Judhāʿah narrated from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
There is no servant who recites the end of al-Kahf when he sleeps except that he wakes from his sleep at the hour that he desires.
ai.seo_question: What is the benefit of reciting the end of Surat al-Kahf before sleeping?
ai.summary: This hadith states the merit of reciting the concluding verses of Surat al-Kahf before sleep. It teaches that whoever does so will awaken at the time he intends, indicating a special effect and blessing attached to this Qur'anic recitation.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1356 - Amir ibn Abdullah ibn Juza'ah narrated from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) who said:
"There is no servant who recites the end of Surah al-Kahf before sleeping except that they will wake up at the hour they desire."
